title: Evaluation of a term by a gate
statement: Let a term on $n$ Boolean coordinates be given, together with an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Evaluating the term with an AND gate gives the term's conjunction evaluation, while evaluating it with an OR gate gives the clause evaluation of the same literals.
caveat: The snippet invokes the term and clause evaluation definitions without supplying their meanings.
